body: Addressed in 5673d20cb: `sha256File` now wraps path resolution, existence checks, file reading, and hashing in `try/catch`, returning `null` on I/O failures.
Addressed in 5673d20cb: `readJsonInput` now wraps path resolution, existence checks, file reading, and JSON parsing in one `try/catch`, returning `null` for missing, malformed, or unreadable input.

Addressed in 5673d20cb: validator input handling now emits `read_path_record_required`, `runtime_result_required`, `evidence_context_pack_schema_required`, and `rag_lite_closeout_required` for missing or non-object inputs, and dependent checks fail closed.
Addressed in 5673d20cb: added regression tests for missing/non-object validator inputs and for malformed schema plus missing closeout file inputs, asserting fail-closed diagnostics.
